title: Muse Meditation Session Calm Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=muse:session calm_score=*
| stats sum(calm_score) as total_value, avg(calm_score) as avg_value by program_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks program values by total and average calm score across Muse meditation session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `calm_score` values for each Muse meditation session event and review total and average calm score by program.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total calm score.
grandmaExplanation: It will count which program shows the biggest calm score numbers in your Muse meditation session data.
